text: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has had thousands of people killed because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to kill the dictator in order to disempower him, his family, and his followers. For this, I and six co-conspirators are asked to ambush and kill the dictator. If I kill the dictator, the people in my country will have a chance for a new start. If I do not kill him, the regime will continue its killings.
